## [FE] Unauthorized Navigation to Super Admin Dashboard

### Summary
The Merchant role can see the Super Admin dashboard link in the navigation bar after logging in, which should not be visible based on role-based access control.

### Environment
- **Browser**: <!-- e.g. Chrome 124, Safari 17, Firefox 125 -->
- **OS**: <!-- e.g. macOS 14, Windows 11, iOS 17 -->
- **Device**: <!-- e.g. Desktop, iPhone 15, iPad Pro -->
- **Screen Resolution**: <!-- e.g. 1440x900, 375x812 -->
- **App Version / Build**: <!-- e.g. v2.3.1, commit hash, staging/prod -->
- **User Role / Auth State**: <!-- e.g. logged-in admin, guest, free-tier user, Merchant -->

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Log in as a Merchant user.
2. Observe the navigation bar.
3. Verify that the Super Admin dashboard link is visible.

### Expected Behavior
The Merchant role should only see the Product Management and Store Dashboard links in the navigation bar. The Super Admin dashboard link should be restricted to Super Admin users only.

### Actual Behavior
The Merchant role can see the Super Admin dashboard link in the navigation bar, which should not be accessible.

### LLM Enhancement Notes
- **Root Cause Hypothesis**: The issue likely stems from incorrect role-based access control (RBAC) implementation in the navigation bar component. The component may not be properly checking the user's role before rendering the Super Admin dashboard link.
- **Likely Affected Files**: `NavBar.js`, `RBAC.js`, `userRoles.js`
- **Suggested Fix Direction**: Implement proper role checks in the navigation bar component to restrict access to the Super Admin dashboard link for non-Super Admin users.
- **Regression Risk**: Medium
- **Severity**: High
- **Priority**: P1
